title: LED on GPIO34 never turns on
serial_logs:
I (312) cpu_start: Starting scheduler on PRO CPU.
I (0) cpu_start: Starting scheduler on APP CPU.
E (322) gpio: gpio_set_direction(277): io_num=34 can only be input
user_question: Code builds and flashes fine but the LED on GPIO34 never lights. Wiring checked.

reference_context.title: ESP32 Series Datasheet (Espressif)
reference_context.section: Appendix A.1 Notes on ESP32 Pin Lists, Table 6-1
reference_context.snippet: GPIO pins 34-39 are input-only. These pins do not feature an output driver or internal pull-up/pull-down circuitry. The pin names are: SENSOR_VP (GPIO36), SENSOR_CAPP (GPIO37), SENSOR_CAPN (GPIO38), SENSOR_VN (GPIO39), VDET_1 (GPIO34), VDET_2 (GPIO35).

expected.root_cause: GPIO34 is an input-only pin on the ESP32 and has no output driver, so it can never drive the LED.
root_cause_keywords: cannot (be used as|drive|act as)( an)? output
expected.fix: Move the LED to an output-capable GPIO such as GPIO2, GPIO4 or GPIO25 and update LED_PIN.
